Fatsees Owners" is

A brand-new portal with two jobs behind one card:

Sell shares — users buy shares in the company (Fatsees AS) directly. The company itself is the seller. It's B shares (no voting rights).
A members-only "Owners area" — anyone who bought shares gets into a closed community. This part reuses the Some/Profile-feed + team-space code you built (posts, likes, moderation, closed membership) — that's why Audun gave it to you.

It is completely separate from Equity — different code, tables, and payment. Equity is a shareholder noticeboard; Owners is the company selling its own shares at a fixed offer price. Never mix them.

Fatsees Equity is a noticeboard where owners of private-company shares advertise
them for sale — legal without a licence only if we never match buyers and sellers,
host deal chat, show live prices, or touch the money.
I'm adding those legal guardrails, removing old features that crossed the line,
and building the allowed ones (contact reveal, wanted ads, history chart, alerts).
In short: Equity must always behave like a noticeboard, never like a stock exchange.
